lines.en: You want to play the airplane game?
You want to show, Rachel?
Come here. You're going to do something fun.
Okay.
I'm so brave. You're so brave.
Yes, you are. You're so brave.
You're okay. Okay, honey, he's fine. He's fine.
Let's just put him down. Come here, babe.
Yes, you're such a good boy.
How could you do that to him?
Ross trusted me. What is he going to say?
He's not going to say anything because we're not going to tell him.
We're not? No, we're not.
All right, I like that. Okay.
So we're okay. We're okay. We're okay, aren't we?
No, we're not okay. We're not okay. There's a bump.
There's a bump. There's a bump.
Oh, my God. Well, push it in! Push it in!
I cannot push it in!
Okay. We're going to need a distraction.
Okay. That's it. Okay.
- I got it. - Okay.
The second that Ross walks in that door,
I want you to take him back to your bedroom,
and you do whatever it is that you do
that makes him go, "Whee!"
Or...
We could put a hat on his head.
A hat. Yes!
- A hat. - We need a hat.
We need a hat. Where are we going to find a tiny little hat?
Whoa, whoa, whoa. Get ready, Day Bear.
I guess he'll know what to do?
Oh, my God. You're a genius.
Oh, God. It's kind of sewn on, though.
- Give it. Give it. - Okay.
Oh, it's just like a bloodbath in here today.
